webhook-failure.label: First webhook test fails; retry succeeds

inbox-failure.label: First read-status update fails; retry succeeds
inbox-failure.message: Your messages are unchanged. Try again.

save-failure.label: First project save rejected; retry succeeds
save-failure.message: Changes could not be saved. Your draft is still here. Try again.

contact-failure.label: First contact submission fails; retry completes the demo
contact-failure.message: This demo submission could not be completed. Your message is still here. Try again.

bulk-partial-failure.label: Website redesign rejects a bulk change; retry succeeds

loading.label: Loading
loading.description: A pending project request. Resolve it when you are ready to inspect the results.
loading.boundary: The request is held deliberately. Resolve request is a gallery control, not part of the product. No network delay or repeated announcement is generated.

first-use.label: First use
first-use.description: An empty workspace with a direct path to its first project.
first-use.boundary: Create a project to populate this example. The form and save validation are shared with Projects; only this fixture starts empty.

no-results.label: No results
no-results.description: Existing projects hidden by a search with no matches.
no-results.boundary: Clear filters restores existing records; it does not create data. Search, filters and pagination use the live results component.

forbidden.label: Access denied
forbidden.description: An unavailable resource with a route back to permitted work.
forbidden.boundary: Access is a fixed specimen, not a permission service. Back to projects returns to the accessible collection; it does not grant access. The reference route does not return HTTP 403.

not-found.label: Not found
not-found.description: A missing project with a useful destination.
not-found.boundary: The missing record is simulated. Back to projects restores the collection. The reference route does not return HTTP 404.

server-error.label: Server error
server-error.description: A project request fails, then succeeds on retry.
server-error.boundary: Try again resolves a local failure fixture. This example makes no server request and the reference route does not return HTTP 500.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: A connection loss leaves an editable project draft in place.
offline.boundary: Reconnect simulates restored connectivity. Save while offline retains the draft and explains why it cannot finish. No browser connection or offline storage is changed.

reconnecting.label: Reconnecting
reconnecting.description: A retained draft while a connection is being restored.
reconnecting.boundary: Restore connection is a gallery control. There is no timer, automatic retry loop or real connection detection.

session-expired.label: Session expired
session-expired.description: Resume a local session without losing the edit in progress.
session-expired.boundary: The sign-in dialog uses the fixture account, collects no credentials and does not change the demo session. It illustrates draft retention, not production authentication.

update-available.label: Update available
update-available.description: A new version can be applied without interrupting a draft.
update-available.boundary: Update now advances a local version fixture and retains the draft. No service worker, deployment detection or browser reload is implemented.

dirty-form.label: Unsaved changes
dirty-form.description: Leave and resume an edit, or Cancel to discard it.
dirty-form.boundary: Navigating within this example retains the draft. Cancel restores saved values. Reset, switching scenarios and reload intentionally reset the fixture.

save-failed.label: Save failed
save-failed.description: A rejected save keeps the entered values available for retry.
save-failed.boundary: Starts with the named save-failure fixture. Retry save uses the normal shared project mutation and validation; no network request is made.

slow-save.label: Slow save
slow-save.description: A save that takes a moment keeps its button steady and the draft locked until it finishes.
slow-save.boundary: The gallery holds the save for 1.5 seconds before the normal shared project mutation runs; no network request is made. Product saves stay immediate.

destructive-action.label: Destructive action
destructive-action.description: Remove a member only after reassigning their projects.
destructive-action.boundary: The real member-removal dialog and atomic team mutation run in this isolated workspace. Cancel preserves the member and projects; the sole-owner protection remains in the shared domain rule.
